title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Ten distinct study environments in Fitzgerald Library, including collaborative spaces, quiet seating, and reservable rooms.

cards.title: Reference Room
cards.subtitle: Fitzgerald Library main level
cards.notes: Set up at a long table near an outlet, use a library computer if needed, and keep this main-level area in mind for solo or shared work.
cards.short_summary: Main-level tables, power access, seating, and computers support flexible study sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: The library identifies the Reference Room on its main level and says it has chairs, long tables near power outlets, and computers.
cards.source_title: Winona Study Spaces | Saint Mary's Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located in Fitzgerald Library on the Winona campus; no reservation requirement is stated for this area.

cards.title: McEnery Lounge
cards.subtitle: Fitzgerald Library first floor
cards.notes: Bring a partner or spread out individually in this first-floor lounge, then transition to a reservable room if your group needs a closed door.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor lounge designated for individual and group study activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's describes McEnery Lounge as a first-floor collaborative environment with space for individual and group study.
cards.source_title: Winona Study Spaces | Saint Mary's Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located in Fitzgerald Library; no reservation requirement is stated for the lounge.

cards.title: McEnery Room 240
cards.subtitle: Fitzgerald Library group study room
cards.notes: Reserve this room for a small-group work session when a large screen, PC, Apple TV, and webcam would help your team share material.
cards.short_summary: Reservable group room equipped for screen sharing and webcam-based collaboration.
cards.evidence_claim: Room 240 is listed as a group study room with a large screen, PC, Apple TV, and webcam.
cards.source_title: Reserving Winona Study Rooms | Saint Mary's Libraries
cards.access_notes: Currently enrolled students, faculty, and staff book online; obtain the locked-room key from Circulation with a student ID.
